AdverseEventAggregate.description: Source-native aggregation of matching FAERS reports.
x-enum-descriptions: Exact reaction-term buckets from openFDA; reports may contribute to several terms.

AdverseEventSerious.description: Report-level seriousness filter, independent of reaction outcome.

AdverseEventSource.description: An explicit source; never probe the other family.
x-enum-descriptions: Explicit CDC WONDER vaccine aggregate tables.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search five report headers by default. MAUDE accepts device text or a manufacturer, product-code or problem filter. One report may list several devices; filters may match different devices. VAERS accepts MMR, COVID19, COVID-19 vaccine or one exact qualified native influenza code, matched without case; use influenza to list codes and labels. Tables remain separate and are never summed. One report may list several vaccines. VAERS returns five reported symptom rows by default; seriousness and age select independent tables. Counts are reports, not people. Reports do not show that a vaccine caused an event and cannot measure risk or compare vaccine safety.

aggregate.description:
FAERS reaction counts; help search adverse-event
FAERS reaction counts.
Use reactions for source-native count buckets across matching reports. Counts are not rates or causal associations; a report may contribute to several terms. Requires MedDRA and offset zero.

drug.description:
FAERS drug names; OR.
FAERS literal drug name; repeat --drug for OR. A standalone OR joining names inside one --drug value is refused. Other filters AND with the names. BioMCP caps the escaped native query, including filters, at FAERS_QUERY_MAX_BYTES (4096 bytes).

limit.description: Native report headers, counted FAERS reaction terms or VAERS rows; default five.

manufacturer.description:
MAUDE manufacturer.
MAUDE manufacturer phrase on device.manufacturer_d_name. A report may list several devices; filters may match different devices.

offset.description: Native report row offset; reaction counts require zero. VAERS needs its snapshot.

problem.description:
MAUDE product problem.
MAUDE phrase on native product_problems.

product_code.description:
MAUDE product codes; OR.
MAUDE exact native device.device_report_product_code; repeated codes join with OR.

reaction.description:
FAERS MedDRA phrase.
FAERS MedDRA term phrase match, not exact equality.

received_from.description:
First date, YYYY-MM[-DD].
Inclusive FAERS or MAUDE FDA receipt lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM; a month starts on its first day.

received_to.description:
Last date, YYYY-MM[-DD].
Inclusive FAERS or MAUDE FDA receipt upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM; a month ends on its last day.

section.title: VAERS table.
section.x-section-rule: Independent VAERS table; omitted means reported symptoms.

serious.description:
FAERS seriousness flag; help search adverse-event
FAERS seriousness flag.
FAERS report flag: any uses the source seriousness flag; the specific flags can overlap. Never a reaction outcome.

snapshot.description:
VAERS snapshot.
Retained VAERS table for provider-free continuation.

source.description:
Source; default FAERS; help search adverse-event
Source; default FAERS.
FAERS by default; VAERS accepts only exact supported vaccine names.

text.description:
Drug, device or vaccine.
Literal drug text, MAUDE device phrase or exact supported VAERS vaccine.
